why_no_gpu: the shim, the sysfs spoof and NCCL's own IB init all run without touching a device; earlier GPU runs of this bead are recorded in provenance.md sec. 9 and are not what output.log captures.

cpu_runs.what: stages 1-7: vendored header SHA256, ABI pin diff, shim build with its _Static_asserts, dlopen/dlvsym name lists, abi_probe QP state machine, wire_probe cross-process bytes, sysfs realpath spoof
the NCCL arm: arm (a) transport selection PASSES; arms (b) numerics and (c) dmabuf are RED and exit 1, by design, with 7q3w.5 / 7q3w.6 named as owners

wall_bound_note: run.sh measured ~1 s (builds and probes, no device); gpu_arm.sh ~2 s. The bound exists so a loaded box cannot be misread as a failing arm.
